notes.title: Update 1.6.5
notes.content:
(New) Now is possible to change the On/Off status for Advanced Conveyor belt.
 (Fixed) Marketplace projects with Teleports/bridges was corrupting the save data.
 (Fixed) Advanced conveyor belt was not outputting to some machines in some cases.
 (Improved) Disassembler now can also partially disassemble non boxed bundles.
 (Improved) Now is possible to modify multiple drone stations at the same time.
 (Fixed) Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.6.4
notes.content:
(New!) Conveyor belt Adv and S200 version is now available.
 (New!) S200 Delivery stations box stack increased to 20 items.
 (New!) Sales graph shows now the rank-rate.
 (Update) Challenge requirements and rewards have been increased.
 (Improved) Quality check machine now shows the last scanned items info.
 (Improved) Power and sales graphs can be now toggled.
 (Improved) Advanced hologram projector is now 3 times faster.
 (Improved) Factory loading is now 5 times faster.
 (Improved) Drone delivery service request.
 (Fixed) Different forklift speeds was affecting production rate.
 (Fixed) On some devices was not possible to complete the tutorial.
 (Fixed) Sometimes the conveyor belt anim would get stuck.

notes.title: Update 1.6.3
notes.content:
(New!) A new 'Graphics Card' product is now available for production and sale, which includes 16 new items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/afcc05038df67cd26ad25d9401379c44c1ebc20d.png

 (New!) An advanced hologram projector is now available that allows you to tape the floor with a special tape and project the name of the area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/d9201965f4d0c37bd6f36f816b051bcb88e5d3a7.png

 (New!) It is now possible to perform a multiple selection without a dummy block by holding down the ctrl key and the left mouse button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/cbd2f776a9fc7d0ebb8a2391aefc47985b5c55e3.png

 (New!) It is now possible to place more blocks than are available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/7735df6b2bad0e4fc212d2ae7965823e03e21fec.png

 (New!) New explorer interface for Generator and Conveyor Arm machines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/9e0dd8f8b42c3f7ea3fa054a465f384600530ae0.png

 (New!) Automatic purchase mode is now available. Select a blueprint as favourite and activate auto mode.
 (New!) It is now possible to enter a customised amount in the dialogue box during purchase.
 (New!) Disassembly machines now allow their behaviour with bundled products to be configured.
 (New!) Quality check machines now allow you to change the threshold.
 (Improved) Ambient occlusion has been improved over long distances.
 (Improved) Visual controls has been improved.
 (Improved) Market project limit is now 5000 instead of 1000.
 (Improved) The overall gaming experience has been improved.
 (Fixed) The QC rejection of some bundled products was too high.
 (Fixed) After a factory restart with 'Generators OFF/ON' set to off, the tutorial could not be completed.
 (Fixed) The conveyor bridge and conveyor teleport sometimes became clogged.
 (Fixed) An error appeared when trying to delete some machines and a container together.
 (Fixed) Copy/move mode moved incorrectly when the floating UI was too close to the edge of the screen.
 (Fixed) When destroying elements from a Disassembler machine, the machine would get stuck.
 (Fixed) When destroying items from a Drone Station machine, the machine would get stuck.
 (Fixed) Other minor bugs were fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.6.2
notes.content:
(New!) FPS Limiter is now available under settings > advanced settings > Target framerate
 (New!) Marketplace projects now can store up to 20 projects and 1000 blocks per project.
 (Fixed) Placing conveyor teleports between other conveyor teleports was not allowed.
 (Fixed) Now the game keeps running in background.
 (Fixed) Some 3d models had wrong uv mapping.
 (Fixed) Containers output was slow down after reaching 5 or less items.
 (Improved) Performance have been improved.
 (Improved) User experience has been improved.
